sector-11.name: Sector 11
sector-11.about:
Sector 11 is one of Noida's older residential sectors, made up mostly of independent houses and builder floors on Noida Authority plots, with only a small share of apartments. Noida Road and Narmada Marg are the main roads that carry residents in and out, and the sector sits beside Sector 10, Sector 12 and Sector 22. For the metro, families usually use Noida Sector 15 station on the Blue Line.

Because most homes are houses or floors rather than gated towers, a tutor comes straight to your door without society gate formalities, though parking on narrow internal lanes can take a few minutes in the evening. Tutors who already teach in Sector 12 or Sector 22 can reach you on local roads, which makes regular weekday slots easier to keep. sector-12.name: Sector 12
sector-12.about:
Families in Sector 12 mostly live in independent houses and builder floors built on authority plots, with some apartments and a few villas mixed in. It is an established sector with plenty of parks, and residents mention busy local markets and tight car parking as everyday realities. Noida Road, Narmada Marg and Amaltash Marg are the roads people use most, and the sector adjoins Sector 11, Sector 20 and Sector 22.

For home tuition this means easy doorstep access with no society gate to clear, but an evening class near a crowded market lane is best timed so the tutor can find parking. A tutor already travelling to Sector 11, 20 or 22 can fit you into the same route. The nearest metro option is Noida Sector 15 on the Blue Line, which helps tutors who commute without a vehicle. sector-14.name: Sector 14
sector-14.about:
Close to the Delhi border, Sector 14 is a planned residential sector with independent houses and builder floors, plus a few apartment societies. Dadri Main Road and Udyog Marg run nearby, and the DND Flyway approach is close at hand. Noida Sector 15 station on the Blue Line is the nearest metro, with New Ashok Nagar the next stop towards Delhi. Sector 14A, Sector 15 and Sector 16 are its neighbours.

Most homes here are houses or floors, so a tutor usually walks straight in; in the few societies, it helps to register the tutor at the gate once so later visits are quick. Evening traffic builds up on the roads leading to the DND Flyway, so a tutor coming from across the city may prefer a slot before the rush. sector-14a.name: Sector 14A
sector-14a.about:
Sector 14A is a small, low-density residential sector at the Delhi edge of Noida, next to Chilla and the DND Flyway. Its homes are mainly on residential plots rather than in high-rise towers. The Dadri Main Road runs close by, and Sector 14, Sector 15 and Sector 15A lie around it. Noida Sector 15 station on the Blue Line is the closest metro stop for anyone travelling by train.

Traffic heading onto the DND Flyway gets heavy in the evening, so a tutor from Sector 15 or Sector 15A, who can come on local roads, is often the steadiest option. sector-15.name: Sector 15
sector-15.about:
Sector 15 has its own metro stop: Noida Sector 15 station on the Blue Line, which runs towards Delhi via New Ashok Nagar and on to Sector 16 and Sector 18. The sector itself is a settled residential area of plotted houses, builder floors and low-rise apartments, most of it built on Noida Authority plots allotted in the 1980s. Sector 14, Sector 15A and Sector 16 are its neighbours, and the DND Flyway is close by.

For parents, the metro is a real advantage: tutors who do not drive can reach you easily, which widens the choice of teachers for evening slots. sector-15a.name: Sector 15A
sector-15a.about:
The DND Flyway lands in Noida at Sector 15A, making this one of the city's best-connected addresses to Delhi. The sector is low-density and mainly made up of independent bungalows and villas on large plots, with a few builder floors and very few high-rise buildings. Sector 14A and Sector 16 lie beside it, and Noida Sector 15 station on the Blue Line is the nearest metro stop.

What this means for tuition: homes are spacious and quiet, which suits focused one-to-one study, but entry is often managed by house staff or security, so share the tutor's details ahead of the first class. The roads around the flyway approach can back up in the evening, so a tutor from Sector 15 or Sector 16, or one who comes by metro, keeps timings more reliable. sector-17.name: Sector 17
sector-17.about:
Sector 17 is a compact residential sector next to the Sector 18 market, Noida's main shopping hub. Housing is mainly builder floors, independent houses and some apartments. Two Blue Line stations are close by: Noida Sector 16 and Noida Sector 18. Sector 16, Sector 18 and Sector 19 surround it, and residents note that buildings are closely packed.

The flip side is traffic: the area around the Sector 18 market stays busy into the evening, so a tutor who drives should allow extra time or pick an earlier slot. sector-19.name: Sector 19
sector-19.about:

Amaltash Marg and Captain Vijayant Thapar Marg are among the roads that serve it, and Noida Sector 16 station on the Blue Line is the nearest metro. sector-20.about:

sector-21.about:
Much of Sector 21 is taken up by a large RWA-run residential colony of mainly two- and three-bedroom flats spread across several blocks, with plenty of greenery. Noida Road, Amaltash Marg and Swami Vivekanand Road are the main roads around it. sector-22.name: Sector 22
sector-22.about:
Sector 22 is one of Noida's denser residential sectors. It was laid out with Noida Authority LIG and MIG flats and small plots, with larger plots on its outer edge, and the village of Chaura Raghunathpur also lies within the sector. The mix of housing, shops and local markets gives it a busy, lived-in feel. Amaltash Marg and Noida Road run nearby, and Sector 11, Sector 12, Sector 21 and Sector 24 surround it.

sector-23.name: Sector 23
sector-23.about:

sector-25.name: Sector 25
sector-25.about:

Noida Road, Swami Vivekanand Road and the Noida Bypass Flyover are the main roads around it. sector-26.about:

sector-30.name: Sector 30
sector-30.about:
Sector 30 is a residential sector of independent houses and kothis on authority plots, with some apartments, laid out in lettered blocks with green spaces. sector-31.name: Sector 31
sector-31.about:
Sector 31 has two very different parts. Its planned blocks hold independent houses on Noida Authority plots with resident welfare associations, while Nithari village, which lies within the sector, is a dense area of narrow lanes, shops and affordable rented housing. The nearest metro stations are Noida City Centre and Golf Course, both on the Blue Line, and Sector 25 and Sector 30 are among its neighbours.

sector-33.name: Sector 33
sector-33.about:
Sector 33 lies towards the Noida City Centre end of old Noida, and the Blue Line stations at Noida Sector 34 and Noida City Centre are its nearest metro stops. sector-34.name: Sector 34
sector-34.about:

The sector is laid out in blocks, with Blocks A and C given over to residential plots and Block B to group housing, which includes Noida Authority apartment blocks as well as private high-rise societies.

sector-35.name: Sector 35
sector-35.about:
Morna village lies within Sector 35, and the Morna bus stand opposite the Noida City Centre metro station on the Blue Line is the landmark most people use to place the sector. Around the village area, the sector is mostly independent houses and builder floors on plots, with some apartment complexes, and it borders Sector 34 and Sector 32.

Because the sector sits within walking reach of the Noida City Centre station, it suits tutors who travel by metro, and families here often find that a tutor can arrive by train and walk the last stretch. The flip side is the traffic: residents mention congestion near the Morna bus stand at peak hours and tight parking in the older village lanes, so a tutor who drives may prefer a slot slightly before or after the evening rush. sector-36.name: Sector 36
sector-36.about:
Right next to the Noida Golf Course, Sector 36 is one of central Noida's older plotted sectors. It is divided into Blocks A to D, and homes are mainly independent kothis and bungalows built on authority residential plots rather than high-rise towers, with wide, tree-lined roads. Golf Course metro station on the Blue Line is the closest stop, and Botanical Garden, the interchange between the Blue and Magenta Lines, is also near.

For a parent arranging tuition, the houses-and-plots layout keeps things simple: the tutor rings your bell rather than signing in at a society gate. Sectors 35 and 40 and the older sectors around Sector 30 are close by, so a tutor already teaching in one of them can usually fit in a visit on the same evening. sector-37.name: Sector 37
sector-37.about:

Much of the sector is a gated residential community of independent houses, alongside apartment blocks. The nearest metro stations are Golf Course on the Blue Line and Botanical Garden, where the Blue and Magenta Lines meet.

The gated layout means a tutor will usually be checked in at the entrance, so sharing the tutor's name and vehicle details with security in advance keeps the start of each lesson smooth. sector-39.about:

sector-40.about:

sector-44.name: Sector 44

Residents describe the inside roads as clean and quiet, but note that the stretch can feel deserted at night and that evening jams build up near the expressway cuts.

For tuition, plan around the security routine: most homes sit behind a gate where the tutor's name and timing need to be registered, so a fixed weekly slot works best. A tutor already teaching in Sector 129, 132 or 137 can reach you without joining the busiest part of the expressway, while those coming from central Noida should allow for evening traffic. Sector 128 has no metro station of its own, so for specialist subjects such as IB or IGCSE, many families mix home visits with online classes. sector-134.name: Sector 134
sector-134.about:
Sector 134 is an apartment sector: its housing is almost entirely gated societies with two, three and four-bedroom flats, several of them ready and lived in, alongside towers that are still being completed. It lies beside the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway, with Sectors 132, 133 and 135 as its neighbours. The nearest metro is Noida Sector 137 on the Aqua Line, which residents say is not within easy walking reach, and Dadri Road near the sector is known for regular congestion.

That shapes how home tuition works here. Societies ask for visitor entries at the gate, so it helps to share the tutor's details with security in advance and keep the same slot each week. For board-exam revision or a niche subject where no nearby tutor fits, an online tutor with an occasional home session is a sensible middle path. sector-137.name: Sector 137
sector-137.about:
With its own Aqua Line station, Noida Sector 137, opened in January 2019, this is one of the best-connected residential sectors on the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway. Housing is made up of well-established gated societies with modern amenities, and office buildings sit close by, which gives the sector a mixed home-and-work feel. Sectors 134, 136, 138 and 142 are among its neighbours.

Residents mention heavy traffic at office peak hours and a build-up near the main sector entry in the evening, so tutors coming by road should plan around it. The metro helps here: a tutor from a sector further along the Aqua Line can reach the station and walk or take a short ride to your society, which widens the choice for a subject like Physics or Accountancy. Entry is through society gates, so registering the tutor with security keeps the first session smooth. Many families also choose online classes for weeks when traffic or monsoon waterlogging makes travel slow. sector-143.name: Sector 143
sector-143.about:
Families in Sector 143 live mainly in newer gated apartment societies set between Sectors 136, 140 and 144, just off the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway. The sector is reached by Abdul Kalam Marg and Gujjar Road, and it is served by two Aqua Line stations, Noida Sector 142 and Noida Sector 143, both opened in January 2019. Large IT offices are located nearby, adding office-hour traffic.

Residents say traffic on the main roads gets busy at peak times but that the sector itself is peaceful. For tuition this means tutors from Sector 144, 136 or 137 can come by metro or a quick local ride, while after-school slots avoid the office rush. Societies need a gate entry for every visitor, so give security the tutor's name and fixed timing. When a specialist in IB, IGCSE or competitive-exam preparation is not available close by, an online tutor can cover the gap without any travel. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-144.name: Sector 144
sector-144.about:
Sector 144 has an Aqua Line station of its own, Noida Sector 144, on the metro that runs along the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway between Sector 51 and Greater Noida. Housing is mainly gated apartment societies, most of them completed and occupied, with some plotted land still on the market. Sectors 143 and 145 lie on either side, and Sector 168 is also close. Large corporate offices sit in and around the sector, so weekday office traffic shares the local roads.

For a parent, the metro and the neighbouring sectors make finding a tutor easier than in many newer parts of the expressway. A tutor based in Sector 143, 145 or 168 can reach you quickly, and one from further along the Aqua Line can use the station. As with most societies, the tutor will be stopped at the gate for entry, so set up a regular slot and pre-approve the visit. Online classes work well for subjects where you want a particular specialist rather than whoever is closest. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-150.name: Sector 150
sector-150.about:
Sector 150 was planned as a low-density, green sector, with a large share of its land kept for sports facilities and open spaces. Homes are mid- and high-rise gated apartments, and several societies are ready and lived in. For years a ban halted occupancy certificates and registrations across the sector's sports-city projects; after a Supreme Court order in November 2025, Noida Authority opened registrations for about 9,000 flats. The nearest metro is Noida Sector 148 on the Aqua Line, and Sector 149 lies next door.

Residents like the wide roads and calm, family-friendly feel, but say public transport inside the sector is still limited. So most tutors come by two-wheeler or car, and the best matches are those already teaching in Sector 149 or other expressway sectors nearby. Societies have gated entry, so plan a fixed weekly slot the guards know. Because the sector sits near the far end of the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway, many families combine a local home tutor for school subjects with online classes for specialist or exam-prep needs. sector-151.name: Sector 151
sector-151.about:
Sector 151 sits toward the Greater Noida end of the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway, with the FNG Expressway also serving the area. Its best-known housing is a very large completed gated apartment complex of several thousand flats, where families have lived for years, alongside newer societies that are still under construction. Sectors 152 and 153 are among its neighbours, and the sector is still described as emerging, with shops and services growing around the occupied towers.

For home tuition, the main question is distance: the sector is well away from the older parts of Noida, so a tutor already teaching in Sector 150, 152 or nearby expressway sectors is far more practical than one crossing the city after school hours. Large societies usually need a visitor pass at the gate, so share the tutor's details and a regular slot with security. Where the right subject specialist lives further away, online classes, or a mix of online and home sessions, keep lessons consistent through the week. sector-168.name: Sector 168
sector-168.about:
High-rise gated societies make up most of Sector 168, a residential sector on the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway with business parks close by. Apartments range from studios to four-bedroom flats. Sectors 135 and 142 are its nearest neighbours, and the closest metro is Noida Sector 142 on the Aqua Line. Residents praise the expressway connection and green spaces but also say traffic can be exhausting at busy hours and that parking is not well organised in some parts.

For parents choosing a tutor, the practical answer is someone from Sector 142, 135 or 144 who can reach you on local roads, or a tutor who rides the Aqua Line to Sector 142 and covers the last stretch by auto or cab. Societies have gated entry with visitor checks, so agreeing a fixed time and pre-registering the tutor saves delays. Since the sector is still filling up and nearby schools are fewer than in older Noida, online classes are a useful option for specialist subjects. sector-115.name: Sector 115
sector-115.about:
Much of Sector 115 is taken up by the old Sorkha village, where families live in village houses and builder floors, while newer premium apartment projects in the sector are still being built. The Harit Upvan urban forest is also here, giving the sector a quieter, semi-developed character than central Noida. Sectors 116, 117 and 119 lie around it, and the nearest metro is Noida Sector 76 on the Aqua Line.

Residents say public transport inside the sector is limited and that most people rely on e-rickshaws or their own vehicles, so expect a tutor to come by two-wheeler. A tutor already teaching in Sector 116, 76 or 119 is the most reliable choice for regular evening classes. Because many homes are village houses or floors rather than gated towers, the tutor usually comes straight to your door, but narrow lanes can make parking and locating the house tricky on the first visit. Online classes are a good fallback during monsoon, when drainage problems are reported. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.
sector-115.note: Families live mainly in Sorkha village; group housing here (Ivory County) is under construction. Zone fit: sits beside Sector 76/FNG, not truly near Noida Extension.

sector-116.name: Sector 116
sector-116.about:
Sector 116 is a plotted Noida Authority sector, known for residential plots and independent houses along wide internal roads and green belts, rather than high-rise towers. It is still filling in: residents note that many plots are not yet built on, which makes the sector very quiet at night. Sectors 115 and 117 are neighbours, with Sarfabad village and Sector 76 close by. The nearest metro is Noida Sector 76 on the Aqua Line.

Because homes are independent houses, a tutor comes directly to your gate, with no society registration to arrange. The sector's position next to Sector 76 helps: a tutor who already teaches in Sector 76, 115 or 117 can reach you on local roads, and one from further away can use the Aqua Line to Sector 76. Residents mention growing traffic at the Sector 76 and 116 junction, so early-evening slots are easier. With fewer tutors living inside the sector itself, online classes are worth considering for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.
sector-116.note: Zone fit: sits beside Sector 76; not truly near Noida Extension.

sector-117.name: Sector 117
sector-117.about:
Sector 117 is a mixed residential sector where families live in Noida Authority flats built under the Samajwadi Awas Yojana in the sector's abadi pocket, ready apartment societies and some independent houses, while larger private projects are still under construction. The FNG Expressway serves the area, and Sectors 116, 118, 119 and 120 lie around it. Residents of the Authority flats have pressed for a park, since children often play on the roads.

For a family here, the nearest tutors are usually those already teaching in Sector 116, 118 or 119, who can come by two-wheeler without joining heavy main-road traffic. Road congestion is reported at busy hours, so an after-school slot before the evening rush works best. Some homes are in gated societies that need a visitor entry, while others open straight onto the street. As there is no metro station in the sector itself, online classes are a practical choice for subjects where the right specialist lives further away. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-118.name: Sector 118
sector-118.about:
Sectors 117 and 119 border Sector 118, a compact residential sector with Sorkha village nearby. Housing is mainly gated apartment societies, some offering affordable two and three-bedroom flats and others more premium, with newer projects still being built around the established ones. The sector links to the FNG Expressway and sits in the band of sectors between the Aqua Line stations at Sector 76 and Sector 51.

Because most homes are in gated societies, a tutor will need a gate entry, so share the tutor's name and fixed timing with security in advance. Tutors who already teach in Sector 117, 119 or 120 are the easiest to schedule, since they can come over on local roads. There is no metro station inside the sector, so tutors from further away usually need a two-wheeler or cab for the last part of the trip. Online classes are a good fit for specialist subjects, or for weeks when evening traffic makes a home visit hard. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-119.name: Sector 119
sector-119.about:
Sector 119 is a group-housing sector of gated apartment societies with two to four-bedroom flats, several of them ready and occupied and at least one still under construction. It sits beside Sectors 118 and 120, with Sectors 121 and 122 also nearby, in the cluster of sectors close to the Greater Noida West border. Stray cattle on the roads are a commuting complaint that residents here and in nearby sectors raise.

Home tuition here follows the society routine: tutors register at the gate, so it helps to fix the same slot each week and pre-approve the visit. Tutors living or already teaching in Sector 118, 120 or 121 can reach you quickly, while those coming from central Noida should allow for the evening rush. There is no metro station inside the sector, so most tutors travel by two-wheeler or cab. For IB, IGCSE or competitive-exam subjects, where a nearby specialist is harder to find, many families choose an online tutor or a mix of online and home classes. sector-120.name: Sector 120
sector-120.about:
Families in Sector 120 mostly live in large gated apartment societies, including one very big complex of more than 20 towers where some towers are fully occupied and others were completed late. Sectors 119 and 122 are its neighbours, with Sector 117 close by. Residents raise civic issues such as waste dumping and stray cattle, and property registration is still pending in some societies.

For tuition, the gate is the first thing to plan for: every society needs the tutor's details and timing at security, so a fixed weekly slot saves time. Tutors from Sector 119, 121 or 122 can reach you on local roads, while those from further away should allow for evening traffic heading toward Noida Extension. The sector has no metro station of its own at present. Where a particular subject specialist is not available nearby, online classes, or a home tutor for school subjects plus an online specialist, work well. sector-121.name: Sector 121
sector-121.about:
Sector 121 is best known for a very large gated society, a completed complex of 24 towers and around 2,600 flats with roughly 10,000 residents, alongside other apartment societies. It sits beside Sector 122, with Sectors 119 and 120 nearby, close to the Greater Noida West border. Residents report traffic congestion near the FNG Expressway junctions and at nearby intersections.

The gate process matters: register the tutor with security and keep a steady weekly slot. Tutors from Sector 122, 119 or 120 can come by local roads, and it is wise to avoid the evening peak when junction traffic builds. For specialist subjects such as IB, IGCSE or JEE preparation, an online tutor or a hybrid plan keeps classes on schedule. sector-122.name: Sector 122
sector-122.about:
Unlike its apartment-heavy neighbours, Sector 122 is a plotted Noida Authority sector laid out in Blocks A to D, where families live in independent houses and builder floors. Sectors 119, 120 and 121 are close by, along with Bahlolpur village. Roads include the FNG Expressway and Vikas Marg. Sector 122 is one of the stations planned on the approved Aqua Line extension from Sector 51 to Knowledge Park V, though today the nearest metro is still at Sector 51.

Because homes are houses and floors, a tutor comes straight to your door, with no society gate to clear. Residents mention waterlogging in the rains and narrow internal lanes that get congested at office hours, so a fixed after-school slot is easier than late evening. Tutors already teaching in Sector 120 or 121 are a natural fit, and traffic around Gaur Chowk toward Noida Extension is worth avoiding at peak times. Old Noida.fact: Noida was established on 17 April 1976 under the UP Industrial Area Development Act and is run by the Noida Authority, with the city laid out in numbered sectors on a grid road pattern.

The DND Flyway, opened on 24 January 2001, links Maharani Bagh and Nizamuddin in Delhi to Noida at Sector 15A; it has been toll-free since a 2016 Allahabad High Court order, upheld by the Supreme Court in 2018.
Old Noida's Blue Line stations run New Ashok Nagar - Noida Sector 15 - Noida Sector 16 - Noida Sector 18 - Botanical Garden; Sector 15 station opened on 12 November 2009.
Botanical Garden (Sector 38) is an interchange between the Blue Line and the Magenta Line (Magenta added 25 December 2017).
The Sector 18 market below Noida Sector 18 metro station is Noida's central shopping hub.
Older sectors such as Sector 15 and 15A were built mainly as houses on Noida Authority plots allotted in the 1980s; Sector 15A is low-density with bungalows and villas.

Hindustan Times (Sep 2026) reports daily morning and evening tailbacks between the Mahamaya Flyover and the DND exit, worst at the Film City Flyover, where traffic from the expressway, Sector 37, Kalindi Kunj, the Sector 62-18 elevated road and Sector 18 converges.
Noida Film City is in Sector 16A and the Noida Cricket Stadium (Noida Authority) is in Sector 21A.

Central Noida.fact: Botanical Garden metro station, in Sector 38, is an interchange between the Delhi Metro Blue Line and Magenta Line.
The Noida–Greater Noida Expressway begins at the Mahamaya Flyover in Noida and runs to Pari Chowk in Greater Noida.
The Aqua Line starts at Noida Sector 51 station (Block E, Sector 51), which is linked to Noida Sector 52 station on the Blue Line by a pedestrian walkway.
Blue Line stations in or beside the zone include Noida Sector 34 and Noida Sector 52 (both on Captain Shashi Kant Marg), Noida City Centre (Sector 39), Golf Course and Botanical Garden.
Noida Botanical Garden, formed in 2002, covers about 160 acres in Sector 38A.
Many sectors here are plotted Noida Authority sectors: Sector 50 Blocks A to E have about 1,000 houses on plots (Block F is group housing), and Sector 51 has 1,000+ houses in Blocks A to F.
Several sectors contain urban villages: Morna (35), Chhalera (44), Sadarpur (45), Baraula (49), Hoshiyarpur (51) and Gijhore (53).
Residents report peak-hour congestion on Dadri Main Road and Amrapali Road, the main roads running through the zone.

Sector 62 Belt.fact: The Blue Line extension from Noida City Centre to Noida Electronic City opened on 9 March 2019, with stations Noida Sector 34, 52, 61, 59, 62 and Noida Electronic City.
Noida Sector 52 (Blue Line) is the interchange with the Aqua Line at Noida Sector 51.
Sector 62 lies along NH-9 (formerly NH-24); residents report NH-9 congestion at peak hours and near office belts and metro stations.
Sector 62 is a mixed-use sector where residential and commercial areas are kept separate, with universities and IT employers alongside housing.
Sector 62 housing is primarily cooperative group housing societies (CGHS) with multi-storey 2 and 3 BHK apartments.
Sector 55 is largely plotted, with independent houses along Khora Road and Noida 22 Main Road; residents cite peak-hour jams and road encroachment.
Sector 56 has Janta and LIG flats allotted by Noida Authority alongside independent houses; nearest metro stations are Blue Line Noida Sector 59 and Noida Sector 15.
Sector 61 mixes group housing societies with independent floors and houses; residents cite heavy peak-hour traffic and parking problems.

Sectors 70–82.fact: The Aqua Line runs Noida Sector 51, Noida Sector 50, Noida Sector 76, Noida Sector 101, Noida Sector 81 and on toward Greater Noida.
Noida Sector 76 is an elevated Aqua Line station opened on 25 January 2019.
Sectors 74 to 79 are mainly high-rise gated group-housing societies; Sector 76 was divided into large group-housing plots allotted to builders.
Vikas Marg is the main connector of the belt; residents report heavy congestion on it during office peak hours.
Residents report the junction near Noida Sector 101 metro station jams at peak hours.
Residents report bottlenecks at the Sector 71/51 intersection at peak hours.
Sectors 70 to 73 are lower-rise, with builder floors, independent houses and smaller societies; much of Sector 73 is Sarfabad village.
Sector 82 is an older pocket-based sector with housing from EWS flats to HIG duplexes on Dadri Main Road; NSEZ (Aqua Line) is its nearest metro station.

Noida Expressway.fact: The Noida–Greater Noida Expressway is a six-lane expressway of about 24.5 km running from Mahamaya Flyover in Noida to Pari Chowk in Greater Noida.
It was built to relieve the already congested old Delhi-Agra highway (NH-2).
The Noida Metro Aqua Line, operational since 25 January 2019, runs from Noida Sector 51 to Depot Station in Greater Noida with 21 stations, including Noida Sector 101, 81, NSEZ, 83 and 137 to 148.
A significant segment of the Aqua Line route runs along the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway.
The expressway belt is lined with high-rise group-housing societies from many developers, across affordable, mid and luxury segments.
Slow-moving traffic in both directions during evening peak hours has been reported on the expressway.
Some sectors near the start of the belt, such as 92, 99 and 108, are largely plotted Noida Authority sectors with independent houses rather than towers.
The Aqua Line opened on 25 January 2019 with 21 elevated stations; along the expressway it serves Noida Sector 137, 142, 143, 144, 145, 146, 147 and 148 before continuing to Greater Noida.
Nearly 10 lakh vehicles use the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway daily, causing heavy peak-hour traffic.
Noida Authority approved a Rs 500-crore, 29-km four-lane road along the Yamuna-Hindon doab as an alternative to the expressway.
Housing in expressway sectors is dominated by high-rise gated group-housing societies (mainly 2-4 BHK apartments).
Sector 150's sports-city projects were under a ban on OCs and registrations from 2021; after a Supreme Court order of 24 Nov 2025, registrations opened for about 9,000 flats.
A large township across Sectors 128, 129, 131, 133 and 134 was due around 2011-12; some flats were delivered but thousands were delayed after the developer's insolvency.
Residents of Sector 137 report heavy peak-hour traffic and waterlogging in monsoon; Sector 168 residents also cite heavy traffic.

Near Noida Extension.fact: UP Cabinet approved the 17.4-km Aqua Line extension from Sector 51 to Knowledge Park V (Rs 2,991.60 crore) with stations including Sector 61, 70, 122 and 123.
Gaur Chowk, the junction toward Noida Extension, handles about one lakh vehicles a day; an underpass there has been under construction to ease jams.
Sectors 119-121 are mainly gated group-housing societies; Sector 121 has a single society of about 2,600 flats and roughly 10,000 residents.
Sectors 116 and 122 are plotted Noida Authority sectors (independent houses/builder floors); Sector 122 is laid out in Blocks A-D and many Sector 116 plots are still unbuilt.
Sector 117 has about 300 Samajwadi Awas Yojana flats in its abadi area, with residents seeking a park.
Sector 115 is centred on the old Sorkha village and the Harit Upvan urban forest; the nearest metro for Sectors 115-116 is Noida Sector 76 (Aqua Line).
Stray cattle blocking roads is a reported commuting problem in Sector 119 and nearby sectors.
